item.title: Full-Stack Developer, Early Career
item.description:
Saffron Studio is a product studio in Stockholm that builds ordering, loyalty and kitchen-display apps for restaurant groups across the Nordics. We are 25 people and we ship everything in-house, from design to infrastructure.

About the role

Our early-career developers work on real client projects from week one, with a buddy and a clear growth plan. You will mostly work on our Next.js and Node.js platform.

What you'll do

  • Build features across our React / Next.js front ends and Node.js (TypeScript) APIs.
  • Model menus, orders and loyalty points in PostgreSQL.
  • Write tests, review code and join client demos.

Must have

  • Up to 2 years of professional experience with JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • Experience with React and with building REST APIs in Node.js.
  • Basic SQL.

Nice to have

  • Next.js, Prisma, or Stripe integrations.
  • Experience with mobile (React Native).

The details

Fully remote within CET +/- 4 hours, or from our Stockholm office. SEK 38,000-44,000 per month for Swedish employees; contractor rates elsewhere. Five weeks of vacation.
